recommendation: Keep this fix as-is. It completes the seed rename for active core narrative while respecting the later out-of-core ClinicalAssessment scope.
issue_request: FHIR-46596 was Applied/Persuasive for R6 and requested renaming the ClinicalImpression resource to ClinicalAssessment, including text references.
initial_application: The rename was substantially applied by J#46596 commit 670d3a407a and PR #3441 merge 256c9d420e, which added ClinicalAssessment source files and updated fhir.ini and many references. Later-added nutrition module use-case text still contained ClinicalImpression.
additional_context: FHIR-50192 later removed the invalid ClinicalAssessment-rather-than-ClinicalAssessment rationale from the resource definition. Current source/fhir.ini no longer lists ClinicalAssessment or ClinicalImpression as active core resources after fad1b9cf84 moved immature resources out of core, and current active pages link ClinicalAssessment to the PC incubator.
reconciliation: Updated source/nutrition-module.html to use ClinicalAssessment in three active use-case parentheticals and source/resourceguide.html to remove the tautological ClinicalAssessment alias phrase. Historical release notes and out-of-build resource directories were left unchanged.
source_changes: source/nutrition-module.html: replaced three stale ClinicalImpression parenthetical resource references with ClinicalAssessment in active nutrition use cases.
source/resourceguide.html: removed the duplicate '(aka ClinicalAssessment)' phrase from the active ClinicalAssessment narrative.

related_jiras.note: Applied cleanup that removed the invalid ClinicalAssessment-rather-than-ClinicalAssessment sentence from the resource definition after the rename.
Duplicate report of the same invalid post-rename sentence handled by FHIR-50192.
Older Published decision kept ClinicalImpression; FHIR-46596 later reversed the naming decision for R6.

evidence_items.summary: Applied/Persuasive R6 issue requesting ClinicalImpression be renamed ClinicalAssessment and related text be updated.
evidence_items.learned: This establishes the final work-group naming decision for the seed issue.

evidence_items.summary: The active resources list contains neither ClinicalImpression nor ClinicalAssessment, while the ballot roadmap links ClinicalAssessment to the PC incubator.
evidence_items.learned: ClinicalAssessment is not an active core resource in the current build, so source changes should be limited to active core narrative references.

evidence_items.summary: The active nutrition and resource guide pages contained stale ClinicalImpression or duplicate ClinicalAssessment alias text.
evidence_items.learned: These active narrative pages were the remaining current-spec source defects tied to the rename.

evidence_items.summary: J#46596 and PR #3441 applied the main ClinicalImpression to ClinicalAssessment rename across source files and fhir.ini.
evidence_items.learned: The seed issue had a substantial prior application, with only later-added or missed active text needing correction.

evidence_items.summary: The later 'remove additional resources' commit removed ClinicalAssessment from active fhir.ini resource entries and retargeted active links to the PC incubator.
evidence_items.learned: The current reconciliation should not reactivate or edit out-of-build ClinicalAssessment/ClinicalImpression resource definitions.
